title: A Wasp Stings a Cockroach's Brain and Leads It by the Antenna

scenes.text: A wasp can lead a cockroach by its antenna.
The jewel wasp stings twice. The first sting hits the body and paralyzes the roach.
The second sting goes into the brain.
The roach stays alive but stops running. The wasp bites off part of an antenna and uses the rest like reins.
She walks it to a burrow, lays one egg on its leg, and seals it in.
The larva eats the roach until it has had its fill. A zombie, led by the antenna.

description:
A jewel wasp can lead a cockroach around by its antenna.
It stings the roach twice, the second time into the brain, then walks it to a burrow, lays an egg on its leg and seals it in.
Would you rather meet this wasp or the zombie ant fungus?
